NAME: Rhys
TEXT: Rhys is a super affectionate boy and a true “leaner,” always ready for cuddles. He loves to play and even knows how to fetch – a rare talent for a greyhound! Rhys enjoys his walks and is always excited to meet new people along the way. He gets along well with other medium to large dogs, so with a successful meet and greet, he could happily share his home with a canine companion. While he’s shown he can settle well indoors, Rhys would love a home with a yard where he can stretch his legs, play, and bask in the sunshine. A household with adults or older children would be the perfect match for this handsome, playful boy. If you’re after a fun-loving companion with plenty of affection to give, Rhys is ready to steal your heart!

NAME: Snake
TEXT: Snake is a friendly, affectionate boy who’s ready to bring light and joy into his new home. He’s a clever lad who comes when called, loves his treats, and walks beautifully on lead, making outings a breeze. He has shown positive interactions with other Greyhounds and may be suited to living with another medium to large dog for company. Confident, sweet, and handsome, Snake is eager to start his next chapter with a loving family. If you’re looking for a loyal companion with plenty of charm, Snake might just be the perfect match

NAME: Judy
TEXT: This beautiful girl is quiet in nature and can’t wait to bring lots of love into her new home! Judy gets along well with her Greyhound mates so she may suit a home with another medium to large breed, pending a meet and greet. A home with adults, older children and someone home more often than not would suit Judy best. Judy walks great on lead, can settle well inside and has attempted stairs so a townhouse or an apartment could be just the place for her. If you're looking for a sweet new addition to your family, Judy might just be the girl for you. Come and meet her at Western Sydney!

NAME: Spud
TEXT: This gentle boy is the epitome of calm and cuddly, making him the perfect companion for families. Spud is well-mannered and easy to walk on a lead, never pulling or jumping. He adores children and has been living happily in a home with kids. Spud gets along wonderfully with other greyhounds and friendly medium-larger breeds, best with females. His easy going nature and big teddy bear personality make him a perfect pet part-time or working from home owners, though he can settle on his own for a while. Spud can be adopted at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Hawke
TEXT: Hawke is a playful and happy boy 🐶, full of energy and confidence. He loves toys, gets excited easily, and brings joy wherever he goes! With a safe and slow introduction, Hawke has the potential to become best friends with your smaller dogs and even cats. He’s also great around young children, making him a fun and loving addition to a lively family. ❤️

NAME: Raffy
TEXT: Raffy is a lounge-loving sweetheart who adores quiet companionship. Perfect for full-time workers or older adopters, she’s happy to rest during the day and curl up on the couch at night. Calm, loyal, and affectionate, Raffy is a gentle friend ready for a loving home.

NAME: Gem
TEXT: Petite and beautiful, Gem has been raised with love and care. She’s crate and toilet trained, great with other dogs, and even suitable for apartment living with the right introduction. Gentle, adaptable, and affectionate, Gem is a sparkling addition waiting to brighten your life.

NAME: Mikey
TEXT: Soft-hearted and affectionate, Mikey is wonderful with teenagers and thrives in a family setting. He’s happy to play during the day, cuddle at night, and wait patiently while you’re at work. Gentle, loyal, and always ready for a hug, Mikey is a boy who will quickly steal your heart.

NAME: Samantha
TEXT: Gentle and affectionate, Samantha has been raised around children and is wonderful with them. Crate-trained, toilet-trained, and adaptable to apartment living, she’s ideal for families or full-time workers. Samantha is a sweet girl with a loving nature, ready to bring warmth into her new family’s life.

NAME: Tommy
TEXT: Mr. Cool, Calm and Collect Sweet Boy Tommy is here to brighten your Day. Do you have lounge or soft comfy bed for this boy? He is more than happy to sleep the day away and wait your return. This boy has meet and had some doggie sleep overs with Maltese x and another greyhound. He also enjoyed the company of some young, human siblings from 3yrs of age.

NAME: Harper
TEXT: Meet Harper – your gentle, loving companion! Harper is a sweet, beautiful-natured little girl. At first she can be a little shy, but soon comes out of her shell & will shower you with affection. She is friendly and loves children 5+, a pat from a stranger or the vet and outings in the car, splashing in ponds, a shell pool or a nice warm hydrobath. She isn't over energetic, loves a walk but ok to miss a day or two. She loves the comforts of her bed at home! Harper gets along with dogs big and small and, once settled, she’s happy on her own – content to rest after her walk, snoozing on her bed or soaking up the sunshine outside. A small yard is fine for her during the day. Harper is a kind and gentle soul would would make a wonderful and loyal companion. 💖

NAME: Dasha
TEXT: Meet Dasha – the darling girl with a playful streak! Dasha is a loving, calm, and confident girl who brings just the right mix of fun and relaxation. She enjoys her morning zoomie, a walk during the day, and another burst of play in the evening – the rest of the time, she’s more than happy to lounge on the couch. She's a cuddly teddy bear! She’s great with little dogs, friendly with other greys, and would suit a family with kids 10+ or a companion home. Dasha is housetrained (she’ll let you know when she needs to go out!) and settles well on her own once comfortable. This chatty girl does have one funny quirk – a love for toilet paper – so keep your bathroom doors closed! With her gentle nature and sweet personality, Dasha will make a wonderful family pet or loving companion.💘

NAME: Luna
TEXT: Meet Luna – Your Perfect Little Companion! Luna is a young, happy girl with a heart full of love. She’s friendly with cats, gets along wonderfully with all dogs, and is great with kids aged 5–7 years. She’s been enjoying a bit of indoor living lately, happily snoozing between her time outside and going for walks. Luna would love a home with another dog for company, or with someone who’s home and can take her out for walks and social time with other dogs or greyhound groups. Luna is a easy on the lead, enjoys a good zoomie, and is just an all-round delightful little girl ready to find her forever, loving home.💖

NAME: Azzie
TEXT: Great with young children. Happy go lucky guy. Calm, friendly & sweet natured. Good with smaller breeds of dogs. A quieter lifestyle would be best. If you might consider welcoming two greyhounds into your home, Azi’s brother Arrie is also searching for his forever home :)

NAME: Callie
TEXT: Callie is a very sweet little lady who shines once she feels comfortable. She loves jumping up for snuggles and cuddles, and enjoys chasing toys during playtime. Callie has grown up around children and would do well with the company of medium to large dogs. Gentle, playful, and full of heart, she’s ready to find a loving home to call her own.

NAME: Louise
TEXT: Louise is getting great pet prep at the moment spending a lot of time with young kids and small dogs. She is loving relaxing in the home without issue and she gets along with every creature she comes across.

NAME: Tilly
TEXT: Tilly has had good inside experience, she gets along great with other dogs. She likes to engage and play followed by some serious relaxing. She is soft and gentle with young kids and great company.

NAME: Gracie
TEXT: Gracie is a lovely affectionate girl that would love your company. She has had inside experience, she has been cared for and walked by young kids and has lived around a kelpie and a cavalier along with other greyhounds.

NAME: Karin
TEXT: Karin is a lovely playful character. She is friendly and social with dogs of different breeds shapes and sizes, she is cat workable and she has also had exposure to native animals. She would suit most homes and can be left alone.

NAME: Tess
TEXT: Tess is a little angel with a beautiful, gentle nature. She’s a quiet girl who will need a bit of time to settle in at her own pace, but once she feels safe and comfortable, she’ll become your loyal shadow and best friend. She’s shown no interest in our resident cat, so with slow and careful introductions, she may be cat workable. Tess might also benefit from having a calm canine companion, but she’d prefer a relaxed dog rather than one with intense energy. Her ideal home is a quiet one, where she can truly relax and feel at ease. Tess loves nothing more than curling up on the lounge for a cuddle. While she enjoys her walks, she can get a little excited and may need some gentle guidance on the lead as she continues to learn. With a bit of patience and a lot of love, Tess will blossom into the most devoted and affectionate companion.

NAME: Bossy
TEXT: Bossy is a gentle, sensitive soul who is looking for a calm and understanding home where he can feel safe and supported. He’s a shy boy who will take some time to build confidence, but with patience and consistency, his sweet nature will begin to shine through. While Bossy hasn’t lived inside full-time, he does have some experience being indoors and is already showing great house manners. He’s house trained and walks beautifully on lead, making him a lovely companion for someone after a quiet, easygoing dog. His chill, couch potato vibes mean he’s happiest in a relaxed environment and could potentially suit apartment living if it’s peaceful and predictable. Bossy has shown little interest in our resident cat, so he may be cat and small dog workable with slow and gentle introductions. He also seems comfortable being left alone for periods, which makes him quite adaptable once settled. With a soft bed, gentle guidance, and time to adjust, Bossy will make a calm and loyal addition to the right home.

NAME: Elly
TEXT: Elly is a bright, energetic greyhound with a big, happy personality that’s guaranteed to make you smile every day. She’s best suited to a home with an active lifestyle, where she can enjoy regular walks, plenty of enrichment, and space to unleash her pretty impressive zoomies. She currently lives with whippets and enjoys their company, so she'd likely benefit from having another doggo friend to play and relax with. Elly is small dog workable with slow and respectful introductions, and she’s learning her manners — she’s food motivated and already understands “no,” which makes her a great candidate for continued positive training. Despite her bursts of energy, Elly also knows how to switch off and chill out with her people. She’s affectionate, fun-loving, and full of character - the kind of dog who brings joy and laughter into every day.

NAME: Benji
TEXT: Benji is a sweet and easygoing greyhound who would be the perfect match for someone with a semi-active lifestyle. He enjoys his walks and a good zoom around the yard, but he’s just as happy to curl up on the couch for a cuddle. More of a homebody at heart, Benji is a real people dog who thrives on companionship and being part of the household. He’s a big fan of toys and loves a play session, especially if it’s followed by some quality nap time. Benji walks well on lead and is great with kids, making him a lovely addition to a family environment. He currently lives happily with little whippets and may benefit from having another dog for company. With small dogs and cats, slow and careful introductions will be important, but he shows potential to adjust. A home with a backyard is a must for Benji so he can enjoy his zoomies and outdoor time. Overall, he’s a gentle, affectionate boy who just wants to be close to his people and enjoy the simple pleasures of life.

NAME: Bob
TEXT: Bob is a vibrant and playful greyhound who’s full of life and always ready for the next adventure. He would thrive in an active home with a yard to run around in and older kids to keep him company. Bob is high on life, he loves his zoomies, enjoys playing with toys (his absolute favourite activity), and is always up for a cuddle once he’s had his fun. He walks well on lead and is very social, enjoying the company of people and other dogs. While he’s not a fan of cats, he might do well with a medium to small dog in the home, provided introductions are done slowly and with care. Bob travels beautifully in the car and takes everything in stride. He will need an experienced owner or someone patient and understanding, as he may take a little time to learn house manners and settle into a routine. He’s smart, enthusiastic, and eager to please, he just needs the right guidance. Overall, Bob is just happy to be here. With the right family, he’s going to be an incredibly fun and loving companion.

NAME: Camo
TEXT: Camo is a sweet and gentle greyhound looking for a semi-quiet life with a family who can give him the balance of fun and relaxation he enjoys. He’s the kind of dog who’s happy with a walk, a good zoomie session, and then settling in for some cuddle time on the couch. He walks well on lead and enjoys getting out and about, but he’s not overly high energy. At home, he’s currently living with a Jack Russell and gets along well, so he should be fine with small dogs. He may benefit from having another dog in the home as a companion, but he could also settle as a solo dog with the right people around him. Camo is fine with kids and would be a lovely addition to a family. However, he is not cat workable, so a feline-free home is essential. Overall, Camo is a calm, affectionate boy who just wants a warm spot, some love, and a bit of fun in his day.

NAME: Zena
TEXT: Zena is a happy, friendly girl, who would suit a nurturing, calm household to really thrive into the cheeky confident girl we've seen here! A home without kids would support her confidence the best. She can live with another calm dog her size and loves to settle down in a cozy area, and does best indoors in a quiet room. A house with a backyard is best suited. This gorgeous girl has shown us her confident side by conquering our stair cases here! Zena is available at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Charlee
TEXT: Charlee has been living with another greyhound, small dogs and cats in a home setting. Charlee is a beautiful girl who walks beautifully on the lead, and has even met the family cat and Jack Russell! She has experience around kids 3+ and would fit in well with a family looking to add a furry friend to their home. She is playful with the kids so kids who enjoy a fun pet would be best suited to Charlee. She loves visiting the river, travels well in cars, OK in crates, and even fine at the vets. She's a super friendly, happy girl who is also great with other greyhounds, making her a lovely fit for many homes! Charlee is used to having a backyard so a home with a townhouse/backyard would be a great fit. She is available to adopt from the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Shelby
TEXT: Shelby has been living with another greyhound, small dogs and cats in a home setting. Shelby is full of fun, loves to play with her toys and shows off her confidence when interacting with the new humans she meets. Shelby loves other dogs, showing her excitement for play and making friends when she meets other 4 legged friends. She even currently lives with a Jack Russell, so pending a meet and greet, could very well go home with a feline or canine bestie. Come down to Western Sydney to meet Shelby! She just might be exactly what you're looking for 🐾

NAME: Melody
TEXT: Melody is a sweet girl who has spent a large part of her life as a lounge lizard. Melody is perfect for people who work during the day and cuddle up on the lounge at night. Melody loves travelling in the car even if it means going to the vets for a visit. Melody is perfect for the older quieter person looking for a great companion. Melody has lived with other greyhounds but is not a fan of smaller animals in any form

NAME: Larry
TEXT: Larry is a beautifully nature boy who would make a great addition to any family. Larry is experienced around kids as young as 1 year old and is soft and gentle around them. Larry enjoys a play around the backyard and is fine with being left alone during the day whilst you work. Larry is crate trained overnight and settles into new environments seamlessly

NAME: Cleo
TEXT: Cleo is a gentle girl, with some experience with kids 6-16. Her favourite past time is indulging in a McDonalds soft serve ice cream, or playing with toys. Cleo has done some extra pet prep prior to meeting you, including going inside the house, meeting small dogs, birds, and more children! She's particularly well socialised around other greyhounds so a home with another dog would be a good fit. She's described as sensible, with a good food drive for training, as well as playful, but shy at first. Come meet Cleo at Western Sydney!

NAME: Gary
TEXT: Hey mate, the names Gary, good to meet ya! I am a lovely, happy boy, and pretty much a friend to everyone I've met. Everyone loves Gary, if I do say so myself! I'll wag my tail like crazy, probably do a zoomie, but I don't mind my down time too mate! I reckon I could get along with your dog if you've already got one at home, and even those little trouble makers at home, I figure kids would be great fun, more attention for ol' Gary! Give me a backyard or a townhouse and I'll make myself right at home. I might not have been a pet before but I have such a can do attitude, I'll fit in anywhere. Come meet Gaz at Western Sydney.

NAME: José
TEXT: Hi! I have just met you and I love you! I'm José, a friendly, confident boy, I love people, pats and attention! I hope you can see how full of love I am from my cute photos. I will put my head on you and ask for more pats! I'm a sweet guy who is good around other dogs, including mingling with small dogs at times. I don't mind chilling out in a crate but I don't need one! I'd love a backyard, a social life, adventures, and maybe even children to give me lots of pats and adoration, too! Meet me at Western Sydney!

NAME: Pat
TEXT: Hi, I'm Pat! I promise to be the bestest boy ever! I hope you like me too. I am a very friendly and affectionate boy. I love food and can be a little shy. I am called a lounge lizard by my current family. I've even done things like go to the beach, meet children, and see the sights on street walks. I don't really show much interest in toys but I have perfected the greyhound zoomie. A paddock gallop is my 'happy place'. I hope you have a backyard for me to chill out in! You can meet me and "Pat me" at the Western Sydney adoption centre!

NAME: Xena
TEXT: Xena is a cheeky, gentle and fun little girl. She likes food, and engages nicely with new people once she warms up from being intially a bit shy. Xena lives with another greyhound at the moment so we think she'd do well in a multi-dog household. Older kids would enjoy her gentle yet curious and playful side. Xena has also done things like street walks, hanging out with children, and other socialisation, making her a great companion for families. Her family say nothing phases her! Xena is available by appointment at the Western Sydney adoption centre!

NAME: Zac (Western Sydney)
TEXT: Zac is a lovely, friendly and confident boy. He has learnt lots about pet life prior to meeting you, including what crates are, the beach, swimming, hangoug out with children, social greetings with visitors to the house, and is very affectionate with people. Zac would be a great addition to a multi-dog household as he currently lives with another greyhound in a house setting. He's described as quiet and laid back, likes his treats and is gentle overall. Zac is available by appointment at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Brown Eyes
TEXT: Quiet, friendly and gentle boy Brown Eyes is a little on the shy side, we think he will warm up with your gentle touch! He shows gentle greetings with small dogs, greyhounds. He walks nicely on the lead out and about, travels well in cars and likes children! Brown Eyes is available at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Lou
TEXT: If you're looking for a inner city dog, someone to come to the pub with you, who confidently navigated crowds and city living, check out Lou. He mastered going to markets, meeting all the stall holders, and even snoozing at the pub on his doggie bed. He lived in a unit apartment, can do stairs, and would benefit from a bigger apartment (more than a 1 bed so he can have a designated safe space), if he was to live in another apartment. Foster care update: "Lou is a beautiful boy with a lot of love to give. He is very good at being left alone for long periods of time, no signs of separation anxiety when we were away at work during the day. He walks very very well on the lead, ignores most birds and bush turkeys. He is not very interested in saying hi to other dogs and will respectfully walk straight past them but loves to have a sniff and play with other greyhounds. He loves squeaky toys with a passion and plays fetch with them with so much joy. He is a master of stairs (our lift went out and he easy walked up and down 5 levels). He would benefit from a bigger apartment/house, our small apartment was a bit tight for him (he likes a safe space). In saying that he still wants to be within eyesight of you. He’s an independent but people loving doggie. He would benefit from an active owner - he is full of beans and loves longer walks and play time. He is most active in the mornings and is up for cuddles and play time, in the evening he likes to curl up and snooze independently." Friendly, charismatic boy Lou ticks all the boxes! Here's why we love him: ✅ Full time workers ✅ Apartment living ✅ Medium to large doggie friends ✅ Affectionate boy with a playful side Apply now to meet Lou from our Western Sydney program!

NAME: Charmaine
TEXT: Charmaine or nickname Chaz is extremely affectionate and lovely to be around. She has a well balanced lifestyle of doing some morning zoomies or fetching toys followed by lounging around the yard. She is currently living the pet life in a suburban backyard around other dogs, enjoys neighbourhood walks and getting some inside experience (with no accidents).

NAME: Roy
TEXT: Meet Roy 🐾💛 Roy is a calm, sweet-natured boy who embodies peace, patience, and quiet joy. This handsome boy is happiest when he’s out and about with his doggy friends, peacefully roaming the yard or going on gentle adventures side by side. Roy gets along beautifully with dogs of all sizes—from fellow greyhounds to the tiniest of pups—always showing kindness, curiosity, and a calm, friendly approach. He would absolutely love a home with a backyard where he can stretch his legs, sniff around, and enjoy the fresh air at his own pace. Roy isn't the kind of dog who needs constant activity—he’s more of a gentle wanderer who enjoys his freedom to explore, lounge, and take in the world around him. Roy’s love for humans is just as strong. He’s wonderful with children and has a peaceful, patient demeanour that makes him a safe and loving companion for families. He’s the kind of dog who fits right into the flow of family life—happy to be around people, share quiet time, or simply nap nearby while you go about your day. If you’re looking for a gentle soul to bring peace, love, and quiet joy into your life, Roy is more than ready to become your loyal companion.

NAME: Jack (Western Sydney)
TEXT: Gentle, calm, and loving Jack is looking for a family where he can have human company, and is looking for someone who adores him. He has shown overall highly calm and affectionate traits here at the centre and we think he'd be happiest with someone home all the time for him. He is suitable around other calm, likeminded Medium-Large dogs, however still requires a human presence. He walks beautifully on the lead, and is ready to accompany you just about anywhere you go. Jack just wants to be by your side, all the time! Jack would love a house with a yard. A home without stairs is best suited. Jack can be adopted from the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Duffy
TEXT: Meet Duffy 🐾💙 Duffy is a happy-go-lucky male with a heart full of love and a tail that never stops wagging. This friendly boy has a special knack for making friends wherever he goes—he absolutely adores other dogs, whether they’re fellow greyhounds or smaller pups. Duffy especially enjoys the company of female greyhounds and would be thrilled to share his new home with a canine companion to play and relax with. But Duffy’s friendliness doesn’t stop with dogs—he’s also wonderful with children, always eager to say hello and share a joyful moment with little ones. His gentle, playful nature makes him a fantastic family dog, and he thrives in environments where there’s plenty of love and laughter. Duffy is happiest when he has space to run and explore, so a home with a backyard would be the perfect place for him to stretch his legs and soak up the sun. When it’s time for a walk, Duffy shines—he walks beautifully on the lead, making every stroll a peaceful and enjoyable adventure for both him and his humans. Despite his playful spirit, Duffy is a calm and easy-going companion who just wants to bring happiness and affection to his new family. He’s a true social butterfly who loves being part of the action, whether it’s a fun play session with his furry friends, a gentle cuddle on the couch, or a sunny afternoon in the yard.

NAME: Zsa Zsa
TEXT: Zsa-Zsa is a quiet, sweet and playful girl. She is looking for a calm and quiet home, either an apartment or house. Her best suited family would be one without children, so she can enjoy the calm serenity of your home while she grows in confidence. She's a lover of treats and food and has grown in confidence here at the centre. She responds best to gentle encouragement, would be happy to live along side another calm and nurturing/older greyhound or Medium-Large doggie pal. She is confident with our training staircase and would suit shorter hours alone while she settles into her new life. She also settles in a crate, however not required. If you have a quiet home and neighbourhood and are looking for a gentle natured canine companion, Zsa-Zsa could be your perfect fit. She can be adopted from the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Lukey
TEXT: Meet Lukey 🐾✨ Lukey is a friendly and affectionate male greyhound who’s already experienced the best of both worlds. Having lived inside a loving home, he’s well-socialized with other animals and absolutely adores people of all kinds. Lukey is a confident, happy boy who loves being out and about in the community—whether it’s a walk in the park, a visit to a café, or simply exploring new places, he takes it all in with a wagging tail and bright eyes. This easy-going guy thrives on affection and will happily shower you with love in return. Lukey’s calm and gentle nature makes him a fantastic companion, ready to settle into family life or enjoy the company of other pets. His experience living indoors means he’s well-behaved and adaptable, making him a smooth fit into homes big or small. If you’re looking for a loving, sociable, and happy-hearted greyhound who’s ready to be your loyal sidekick, Lukey is the perfect match. He’s excited to share his affectionate nature and joyful spirit with a forever family.

NAME: Royal
TEXT: Meet Royal 👑🐾 Royal is a delightful girl who truly lives up to her name. She’s a playful and affectionate sweetheart who adores making friends—especially with other dogs, no matter their size! Royal’s favourite thing in the world is playing with her furry pals, and she’ll happily invite any dog she meets to join in on the fun. Whether it’s a game of chase, tug, or just a joyful romp, Royal is always ready to play. This gentle lady would make a wonderful family pet. She’s calm and confident, not easily stressed by new people or environments, which makes her adaptable and easygoing in all kinds of settings. Royal loves her toys and can spend hours happily entertaining herself or sharing playtime with her favourite humans. When she’s not busy playing or making new friends, Royal is a cuddle bug who loves to snuggle up and soak in all the love and attention she can get. She’s a perfect balance of lively and laid-back—a true joy to have around. If you’re looking for a loving, playful, and incredibly social companion who will bring laughter and warmth into your home, Royal is ready to steal your heart and become your family’s new best friend.

NAME: Tiger
TEXT: Meet Tiger 🐾 Tiger is a confident and charismatic boy with a heart as big as his smile. This energetic bundle of joy is a true social butterfly who thrives on friendship—whether it’s with dogs big or small, Tiger’s easy-going nature and playful attitude make him a favourite in any multi-pet household. But don’t worry, he’s just as happy being the one and only furry family member, soaking up all the love and attention you can give. Tiger is the perfect blend of playful goofiness and calm confidence. He’s always ready to brighten your day with his silly antics, goofy grin, and endless tail wags. Despite his lively energy, he knows how to relax and enjoy quiet cuddle time, making him a well-rounded companion. What really sets Tiger apart is his gentle and loving spirit. He’s great with children, understanding and patient, making him an ideal family dog. Whether it’s playing games in the yard or snuggling up for story time, Tiger is sure to be a beloved member of your home. If you’re looking for a loyal, happy, and affectionate friend who will keep you smiling and fill your days with love, Tiger is the perfect match. He’s confident, outgoing, and ready to bring joy to a home that appreciates a lively, loving, and goofy boy with a heart full of love. Could Tiger be the one to steal your heart?

NAME: Alf (Western Sydney)
TEXT: *Alf has just spent 2 months being a foster care super star with his foster carer in her 80s - he's now back at the adoption centre ready to meet you!* If you're looking for a perfectly behaved boy, read on! His foster carer says "Alf is a beautiful dog not only in looks but in his temperament with humans, and is so very loveable. I have been lucky to have the pleasure of his company for two months. He is intelligent and has calmly learned a lot in his time with me. " Foster Updates: ✅Walks well on a loose lead & harness ✅Climbs stairs very well (15 stairs) ✅Travels in elevators and cars well (Car travel is more for sleeping!) ✅House trained for toileting. Impeccable manners indoors! ✅Obeys commands, come, stay, wait, yes, no, down, off. ✅Answers to name ✅Doesn't take from the bin, or destroy things ✅Trusts and loves all humans ✅Enjoys his toys ✅Can be left alone without fuss ✅Scared of thunder and lightning. Alf finds a quiet, dark room to be in for the duration. He only needs to be close – no hiding, just a little panting for this big boy. ✅Loves rolling on lawn then doing zoomies ✅Enjoys the beach ✅He knows not to be on couches or beds but given licence to do so he would love to accept ✅ Accepts praise and pats where ever he goes, loves all people, big, small, male, female ✅ Affectionate, gentle, a true gentleman Alf is available from our Londonderry adoption centre.

NAME: T Rex
TEXT: Meet T-Rex 🦕 Dog Friendly: Yes – best with medium to large dogs Child Friendly: Yes – best suited to a home with older children Ideal Home: A family with a secure backyard and an active lifestyle Don’t let the name fool you – T-Rex is all heart and happiness! This big, bouncy boy is bursting with personality and ready to find a family who’ll love his enthusiastic, affectionate nature. T-Rex is a social butterfly through and through. He’s currently living with other greyhounds and thrives in their company, especially those who can match his playful energy. He’s also friendly with medium and large dogs, and loves being part of a pack. This boy lives for his people – always close by, always ready to join in. Whether you're moving around the house or heading out for an adventure, expect T-Rex to be your loyal shadow. He’s interactive, affectionate, and happiest when included. T-Rex would do best in a home with older children who can enjoy his energy and help guide his big personality. A backyard is a must – he’s got some serious zoomie skills and needs space to stretch those long legs. While he’s eager to get out and explore, T-Rex can be strong on the lead, so he’ll need confident handlers who can continue his training and help him channel his excitement on walks. He will be your super social and loyal shadow and sidekick If you’re ready for a fun, affectionate, and outgoing greyhound who will bring non-stop joy and energy into your life, T-Rex is your guy.

NAME: Red
TEXT: Meet Red ❤️ Say hello to Red – a tender-hearted boy with a sweet soul and the most soulful eyes you’ve ever seen. Red may be a little reserved at first, but once he feels safe and settled, he shows his loving personality in the most heartwarming ways. Red is great with other greyhounds and enjoys their calm, familiar company. He’s also been around smaller dogs – he just may need a slower, thoughtful introduction to build his comfort and confidence. With the right introductions and guidance, he’s more than happy to share his space with gentle doggy friends. Red has been around children in a home environment and handles it well with his naturally gentle nature. However, due to his shy disposition, a quieter home – perhaps with older, dog-savvy kids – would be the best match for him. He thrives in calm, predictable spaces where he can truly feel at ease. Red can be a bit nervous when meeting new people or exploring new situations, but give him time and patience, and you’ll be rewarded with the trust and love of a truly special dog. He prefers to interact on his own terms – not pushy or demanding, just quietly curious and kind. Red enjoys his peaceful moments, lounging nearby, quietly observing, and choosing when to come over for a little affection or company. His independence, mixed with his loving nature, makes him a calm and comforting presence in the home. Red would thrive in a gentle, patient home where he can settle in at his own pace and build trust with his new family. He doesn’t ask for much – just kindness, understanding, and a safe space where he can be himself. In return, you’ll get a loyal, loving companion with the sweetest heart.

NAME: Finn
TEXT: Meet Finn 🌸 Introducing Finn – a quiet sweetheart with a gentle heart and a peaceful presence. This lovely girl may be a little shy when you first meet her, but once she feels safe, her soft personality begins to shine through 💕🐾 Finn is wonderfully social with other dogs – big or small. She’s respectful, calm, and happy to let others take the spotlight, making her an ideal companion for a household with other canine friends after a slow introduction. 🐕🐾 Finn has lived with children before and is gentle and patient with little ones. While she tends to keep to herself, she’s more than happy to be part of a loving family. She would do best in a home where kids understand that she might need a bit of time and space to settle in. Finn might take a little time to come out of her shell, but once she feels at ease, she’ll quietly sneak her way into your heart. She doesn’t demand attention but loves being near her people, soaking up the calm and comfort of a loving home. She’s the kind of dog who’s happy to do her own thing – whether it’s napping in a cozy spot or quietly observing from a distance. But don’t be surprised if she comes over for a gentle nuzzle or a loving glance – Finn gives affection in her own soft, sweet way. 🥰

NAME: Desert
TEXT: Meet Desert 🐾 Looking for a gentle, loving, and oh-so-handsome companion to join your family? Say hello to Desert – a sweet boy with a heart full of love and a tail that never stops wagging. Desert is the kind of dog that just makes life better. With his sleek good looks, calm nature, and cheerful personality, he’s already stolen plenty of hearts – and now he's ready to find his forever home. Desert is very dog-social, especially with medium and large breeds, and he’s been living comfortably with other greyhounds in his home. Whether it’s playtime in the yard or a quiet nap in a sunny spot, he’s happy to share his space and get along with his canine companions. 🐕‍🦺He enjoys his regular walks through the neighbourhood and handles the hustle and bustle of the street with grace. Desert walks well on the lead and takes everything in with calm curiosity – from passing cars to people and other dogs. He’s a great walking buddy and would love to join you on your daily strolls! Desert has been around children aged 2 to 15 and handles himself beautifully. He’s gentle and respectful, though we think he’d thrive best in a home with older kids who understand how to interact with dogs and give him the space and love he deserves. He’s a lovely mix of calm and affectionate, making him a great match for a family looking for a loyal companion. 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 This boy is full of joy and charm – his tail is always wagging, and his eyes light up when he sees his humans. Desert is affectionate without being clingy, playful without being over the top, and confident without being pushy. He brings a lovely, balanced energy into the home. Desert would be a wonderful fit for a loving family with older children or an individual/couple looking for a loyal companion. He’d love a doggy friend or two (especially if they’re greyhounds!), a safe space to stretch his legs, and a family who will keep him included in everyday life.

NAME: Penny
TEXT: Penny is a gorgeous young girl. She is a gorgeous pup looking to make the best memories with her forever family. With a very affectionate streak and social personality, she would be happy living with children and other dogs. Penny is good left on her own. She will love to greet her family at the end of the day with some snuggles and a treat.

NAME: Shay
TEXT: Shay is a cheerful and excitable girl looking for a new place to call her own. She is a very friendly and affectionate girl. Shay lays in your lap and even roaches on you, hoping to get all the cuddles from you! We think it's just adorable! Shay would suit a backyard and an active lifestyle. She is cheeky, playful and can live with another greyhound/medium to large dog. She loves toys and all things fun, so a home with kids who could keep her entertained would be a great match! She doesn't mind spending some time alone so part time/full time workers could be suitable after she settles into pet life. She has a great drive for training when treats are involved so an owner who enjoys training and teaching dogs valuable skills would be a great fit for Shay! Shay is available at Western Sydney's adoption centre.

NAME: Goose
TEXT: Meet Goose – the big-hearted goofball! 🐾 Goose is a gentle boy who loves being part of whatever you’re doing—whether it’s pottering in the garden, hanging out in the shed, or going for a drive (he’s a great traveller!). He’s recently discovered the joys of indoor life—lounging on the couch or his bed with legs in the air is a favourite pastime! Goose is house-trained, sun-bakes like a pro ☀️, and also enjoys a comfy spot on the verandah or patio. Friendly with everyone he meets, Goose loves toys (especially his beloved soccer ball!), swims, and easy, sniffy walks. He’s met kids 10+ and is calm around other dogs🐶. Goose is easy-going, friendly and happy who would love a home where someone is around more often than not, easily suited to retirees to travel with or someone wanting a companion dog He’s quiet, only giving the occasional bark for more pats or when dinner’s on the way. Apart from missing two toes from an old puppy injury he still likes a walk, preferably on grass, and is a healthy, affectionate boy ready to share his big heart with you. 💙

NAME: Cassie
TEXT: Meet Cassie 🌟 *ATTENDING THE ANU ADOPTION DAY - 6TH SEPTEMBER* If you’ve been waiting for the perfect companion to light up your life, look no further — Cassie is the one. Cassie is a stunning girl with the kindest eyes and a heart full of love. Her gentle, affectionate nature will win you over the moment you meet her. She’s the type of girl who leans in for cuddles, thrives on praise, and will happily soak up every pat you’re willing to give. A true people-pleaser, Cassie absolutely adores affection and being told she’s a good girl! Cassie has lived comfortably inside a home and knows how to be the perfect housemate. She's clean, well-mannered, and loves being part of the daily routine. Whether it's lounging nearby, following you around the house, or settling in for a nap at your feet, she’ll always want to be close. She also gets along beautifully with medium and large dogs, so she’d love a home with a canine friend—or she’d be just as happy as your one-and-only shadow. Her calm and friendly nature makes her easy to introduce to new people and dogs alike. ✨ Why Cassie is the perfect match: • Gentle, sweet, and affectionate — the ultimate snuggle buddy • Calm and easy-going, perfect for families, couples, or individuals • Good with medium/large dogs and has lived happily indoors • Loves pats, praise, and being part of the family • Will bring love, warmth, and peaceful companionship into your life Cassie isn’t just a pet — she’s a confidante, a cuddle expert, and a forever friend. Once she bonds with you, her loyalty and affection are unmatched. She’s ready to fill your home with quiet joy and unconditional love. If you're looking for a gentle, loving soul who will brighten every day, Cassie is ready to meet you. 👇 Click here for information on the ANU adoption day & to register for the dogalogue

NAME: Selwin
TEXT: Meet Selwin 🖤 *ATTENDING THE ANU ADOPTION DAY - 6TH SEPTEMBER* Say hello to Selwin, a gorgeous boy with a soft heart, curious mind, and a lifetime of love to give. Selwin may take a little time to warm up, but once he trusts you, you’ll have a loyal and affectionate companion by your side. Selwin has grown up around children and knows how to be calm and gentle in their presence. He’s also well-socialised with other dogs, getting along beautifully with medium and large breeds—including other greyhounds and even a German Shepherd buddy! He’d love a home where he can share space with canine companions or be your one-and-only shadow. This sweet boy has a thoughtful, inquisitive nature. He enjoys taking in the world at his own pace and has proven to be unfazed by nearby farm animals like sheep and horses—nothing much rattles Selwin's cool composure. What would make Selwin happiest? A quiet home with a backyard or courtyard where he can potter around, stretch his legs, and soak up the sun between naps. While he doesn’t need a lot of exercise, he appreciates the freedom to explore a safe outdoor space. His independent and relaxed personality also makes him well-suited for full-time workers—he’s perfectly happy doing his own thing while you’re away, then greeting you with a wag and a nuzzle when you return. If you’re looking for a gentle, low-maintenance companion with a big heart and a quiet charm, Selwin might just be the boy for you. With a bit of patience and a lot of love, he’ll blossom into your most devoted friend. 👇 Click here for information on the ANU adoption day & to register for the dogalogue

NAME: Barney
TEXT: Meet Barney 🐾 *ATTENDING THE ANU ADOPTION DAY - 6TH SEPTEMBER* Meet Barney, a big-hearted 4-year-old greyhound who tips the scales at 40kg—but still thinks he’s a puppy! He’s a beautiful, soulful boy who’s as relaxed as he is lovable, with a gentle nature and a heart full of love just waiting to be shared. Barney has already experienced the hustle and bustle of Canberra city and handled it like a pro. New environments don’t faze him one bit—he walks with quiet confidence wherever he goes. Whether it’s a city stroll or a café outing, Barney takes it all in stride, always cool, calm, and collected. At home, Barney is an absolute sweetheart—toilet trained, easy to manage, and happiest when curled up in a cozy corner (or better yet, right beside you on the couch!). He’s a true couch potato at heart. While he enjoys a short daily walk or a sniff around the block, he doesn’t require much exercise. Barney is the kind of dog who’s perfectly content to lounge the day away, simply enjoying your company. When he’s not napping, Barney loves indulging in his two favourite things: chasing toys and sniffing out snacks. He’s incredibly food-motivated, which not only makes him adorable, but also highly trainable. He’ll do just about anything for a treat or a squeaky toy and is already showing off his quick-learning abilities. Barney’s calm demeanor and low-energy lifestyle make him a fantastic match for many types of homes—from first-time dog owners and townhouse dwellers to families with children or full-time workers. He’s unfazed by routine, happy in his own company, and easy to have around. All he truly needs is a soft bed, some tasty treats, and a human to love. If you’re dreaming of a sweet, snoozy, super easy-going greyhound who will bring calm, comfort, and companionship to your life, Barney could be the perfect fit. Come meet this gentle boy—you won’t be able to resist his charm. 💙 👇 Click here for information on the ANU adoption day & to register for the dogalogue

NAME: Mick
TEXT: Meet Mick 🐾 *ATTENDING THE ANU ADOPTION DAY - 6TH SEPTEMBER* Say hello to Mick, a sweet and gentle greyhound who’s as friendly as they come. Mick has grown up around children and loves people of all ages, making him a wonderfully social companion who enjoys being part of the family. Mick gets along great with other medium and large dogs, so he’d thrive in a home with canine friends or where he can meet new doggy pals on his daily adventures. He’s bestie’s with a labradoodle! He’s a confident walker who enjoys his lead walks and travels well in the car—ready to go wherever life takes him! When Mick’s out and about, he loves to let loose and get his zoomies out, showing off his playful side with bursts of energy. After a good run, he’s perfectly happy to relax and chill for the rest of the day, making him an ideal mix of active and laid-back. With his sweet nature and easy-going attitude, Mick is the perfect companion for anyone looking for a loving, well-mannered dog who’s great with people and pups alike. 👇 Click here for information on the ANU adoption day & to register for the dogalogue

NAME: Banff
TEXT: Meet Banff 🐾 *ATTENDING THE ANU ADOPTION DAY - 6TH SEPTEMBER* Banff is a handsome gentleman who has grown up in a loving semi-rural home surrounded by kids as young as five, other greyhounds, and plenty of affection. This nurturing environment has helped Banff develop into a fantastic all-round dog who’s gentle, social, and full of heart. Banff is wonderful with people of all ages—he truly adores being part of the action and thrives on family life. Whether it’s playtime with the kids, quiet cuddles, or outings with his greyhound buddies, Banff fits right in and shares his love generously. Eager to please and very trainable, Banff will quickly become your shadow, always by your side, ready to join you in whatever adventure the day brings. He’s a loyal companion who enjoys learning new things and making his humans proud. If you’re looking for a sweet, dependable, and affectionate friend to brighten your life, Banff could be the perfect match. Ready to welcome a loving boy who will be your constant companion? Banff is waiting to meet you! 👇 Click here for information on the ANU adoption day & to register for the dogalogue

NAME: Kozi
TEXT: Meet Kozi 💖🐾 *ATTENDING THE ANU ADOPTION DAY - 6TH SEPTEMBER* Kozi is a gentle, soft-spoken girl who may come across as a little shy when you first meet her. But don’t let her quiet demeanour fool you—once Kozi feels safe and comfortable, her affectionate nature truly blossoms. She has so much love to give and is just waiting for the right calm and relaxed home where she can feel secure and cherished. Kozi thrives best in a peaceful environment where she can take her time to settle in and build trust. She’s an ideal companion for older people or families with respectful older children who understand the importance of patience and kindness. With the right gentle guidance, Kozi will become a devoted and loving friend who treasures every quiet moment spent with her family. This lovely girl travels like a dream in vehicles, making car rides stress-free and enjoyable. She also walks beautifully on the lead, showing a calm confidence when out and about. Kozi isn’t a high-energy dog—she prefers peaceful strolls and relaxing days at home, soaking up affection and gentle company. Kozi’s calm and steady presence makes her a wonderful companion for someone seeking a quieter dog who will offer unwavering loyalty and gentle love. She might take a little time to warm up, but once she does, you’ll discover a truly special bond with a dog who will be by your side through thick and thin. If you’re ready to welcome a soft-hearted, affectionate girl into your life—one who will reward your patience with endless love—then Kozi could be the perfect match. Give her the chance to feel safe and loved, and she’ll become a treasured member of your family. 👇 Click here for information on the ANU adoption day & to register for the dogalogue

NAME: Mia
TEXT: Mia is a playful young girl who likes to play and stretch out before lounging around. She has lived around different sized dogs, domestic and native animals without issue. She is a beautiful affectionate girl who is also good on the lead. She is also comfortable on her own.

NAME: Cobber
TEXT: Cobber is a stunning lad, he is good with kids, social around different breeds of dogs and would be great company. He is easy on the lead and comfortable on his own.

NAME: Vaughn
TEXT: Vaughn has been described by his handlers as simply "amazing"! He is outgoing and affectionate with people & would suit a family home with a yard for him to relax in. He cannot wait to show you his Vaughn-derful personality! He is highly engaged with his training, best suited to house/townhouse living and settles alone well in a backyard setting. He’s already learned a bunch of tricks like 'down', shake, recall, his name, and on/off bed, and he’s currently working on sit. He’s quick to pick things up! He will need a home with a yard where he can run and play till his heart’s content. A family that will continue to help him on his training journey and a calm, loving environment where he can relax and feel secure. His best home is a family who want to do dog training, adventures and cool fun activities with him! Vaughn is available from the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Bub
TEXT: Meet Bub! Say hello to Bub, a sweet-natured older girl who’s ready to enjoy the simple pleasures of retirement. Bub is looking for a quiet, peaceful home where she can soak up the sun, enjoy some gentle pats, and claim a soft, cosy bed as her own. With her graceful charm and soft eyes, Bub has a spring in her step, but she’s very low-maintenance when it comes to exercise – a short burst of energy in the yard, a few short strolls and a bit of backyard sunbathing are all she needs to be content. She would thrive as an only dog, but she’s also happy to share her space with a male greyhound companion. Bub is a great match for full-time workers if there’s a secure backyard where she can relax during the day. She would also suit a calm household with older children who respect her quiet nature. If you're after a gentle soul who’s past the puppy chaos and just wants to be your loyal companion, Bub might just be the girl you’ve been waiting for. ☀️ Loves: Sunbaking, soft beds, peaceful vibes 🏡 Best home: Quiet environment, backyard, solo or with a male greyhound 💙 Personality: Calm, sweet, gentle, quietly affectionate 🦴 Exercise needs: Minimal – a yard for a quick zoom, a gentle stroll, she’s more nap than zoom Let Bub bring serenity, love, and a little sparkle into your life.

NAME: Goofy
TEXT: Meet Goofy! Goofy is an energetic yet laid-back sweetheart who lives up to his name in all the best ways! With his goofy grin, long legs, and heart of gold, this handsome boy is looking for a forever home where he can share his love and charm. Goofy is incredibly friendly and affectionate, making him a great companion for families with older kids or an active couple looking for a fun, loving addition to their lives. He has plenty of pep for zoomies in the backyard or a long walk, but true to greyhound form, he's a professional couch potato and will happily spend most of the day snoozing in comfort. He gets along well with other dogs, especially those his size, and could thrive in a multi-dog household. He would also be perfectly content as an only dog if he has a backyard to enjoy and people to love him. Goofy is suitable for full-time workers, as he's happy to chill during the day and loves his clam shell pool to lie and splash in. If you're after a big-hearted, sweet-natured greyhound who blends goofy energy with couch-loving calm, Goofy could be your perfect match! 🛋️ Loves: Lounging, cuddles, playtime, zoomies, walks, cuddles 🐕 Would suit: Active couple or family with older children 🏡 Best home: With or without other dogs, needs large backyard 💙 Personality: Friendly, outgoing, loveable, goofy, playful

NAME: Zippa
TEXT: Meet Zippa!🐾 Zippa is a charming, affectionate boy who’s never met a dog he didn’t want to be friends with—especially if they’re fellow greyhounds! He thrives on canine company and is always the first to say hello with a happy wag and a gentle nuzzle. This social superstar settles quickly into new environments and brings calm confidence wherever he goes. Whether it’s a bustling park or a cozy home, Zippa makes himself right at home in no time. He absolutely adores human affection and will happily lean in for cuddles, neck scritches, and all the love you’re willing to give. With his friendly nature and easy-going personality, Zippa is a joy to have around and will make a wonderful companion for a home with other dogs—or just humans ready to shower him with love.

NAME: Jazz
TEXT: Meet Jazz! 🎷 Jazz is a laid-back, friendly girl with a lovely nature and a true love for canine company. She currently lives with other dogs and absolutely adores them—playtime with her four-legged friends is one of her favourite things in the world! While she’s polite and relaxed around new people, Jazz is definitely more of a “dogs before humans” kind of girl, always happiest when she’s part of a playful pack. This cool and easy-going girl travels like a pro and is perfectly at ease in the car, making her a great companion for road trips, day outings, or simply tagging along for the ride. Jazz takes everything in stride and brings a calm, contented energy wherever she goes. With her sweet, social nature and gentle personality, Jazz would thrive in a home with other dogs and a relaxed routine. If you're looking for a happy, well-adjusted boy who loves her canine companions and brings a quiet charm to every room, Jazz might just be the perfect match for you.

NAME: Rose
TEXT: Meet Rose!🌹 Rose is as lovely as her name suggests — a sweet, affectionate, and joyful greyhound who’s ready to fill her forever home with love, laughter, and plenty of cuddles. This social butterfly gets along beautifully with other dogs and is wonderful with children, making her a perfect match for a family home or anyone looking for a friendly companion to share life’s adventures. Rose loves her humans and thrives on affection — she’s happiest when she’s being cuddled, fussed over, or showered in kisses (which she’ll gladly return!). With her super affectionate nature and calm, gentle spirit, Rose has earned the title of “big cuddle monster” from everyone who’s met her. Whether she’s curled up next to you on the couch, leaning in for pats, or simply following you from room to room, she’ll always find a way to be close and connected. Rose is a confident, happy girl who’s ready to take on the world with her new family by her side. If you're looking for a loving, loyal, and snuggly companion who will be your shadow and your biggest fan, Rose is ready to blossom in her forever home.

NAME: Pebbles
TEXT: Meet Pebbles! 🐶 Pebbles is a bright, bubbly, and super social greyhound who’s ready to win hearts wherever she goes! This lovely lady has a big personality and an even bigger heart — she adores the company of other dogs and gets along with absolutely everyone she meets, both two-legged and four. Pebbles has been well-socialised in the community and is comfortable and confident in a variety of environments. She’s spent plenty of time indoors and knows how to settle into home life with ease. Whether she's out and about or relaxing at home, Pebbles is always engaged, curious, and tuned into her humans. She’s a huge fan of pats, cuddles, and—of course—treats! Show her a snack and she’ll be your best friend in an instant. Her friendly, affectionate nature makes her a joy to be around, and she’s always up for a chat (or at least a tail wag and a nuzzle). Pebbles would thrive in a home where she can continue being part of the action—whether it’s social outings, doggy playdates, or simply lounging at your feet after a day full of love and attention. If you're looking for a sweet, sociable girl who’s already got the hang of home life and is ready to be your loyal companion, Pebbles is your perfect match.

NAME: Laverne
TEXT: Meet Laverne! 🌸 Laverne is a sweet and sociable greyhound who’s ready to charm her way into your heart — and your home! This lovely girl gets along beautifully with other dogs, especially fellow greyhounds, and would make a wonderful addition to a home with canine companions. Laverne has been exposed to life both indoors and out, and she handles it all like a pro. She’s comfortable walking through busy streets and settles quickly once back inside, making her a great fit for suburban or city living. She's already shown she knows how to make herself at home — whether it’s lounging on a comfy bed or quietly hanging out with her humans. Always up for affection, Laverne will happily trot over for pats, cuddles, and a bit of love. Her gentle, friendly nature makes her easy to fall for, and she thrives on human connection without being overly demanding. With her easy-going temperament and affectionate heart, Laverne is ready to become a loyal and loving house pet. If you’re looking for a sweet companion who’s as calm as she is cuddly, Laverne could be your perfect match.

NAME: Rodney
TEXT: Meet Rodney! 🎾 Rodney is the kind of greyhound everyone dreams of — a friendly, easy-going, and happy soul who makes a perfect family pet. He’s fully house trained, so he knows how to settle into home life with ease and respect your space. Rodney truly loves children and has a gentle, patient nature that makes him wonderful with kids of all ages. Whether it’s playtime or quiet moments, he’s always ready to be a loyal and loving companion. His friendly and sociable personality means he gets on well with all dogs, big or small, and he enjoys meeting new furry friends wherever he goes. One of Rodney’s favourite pastimes is playing — especially chasing and retrieving balls! He’s got a playful spirit that can light up any backyard or park outing, but he’s just as happy curling up for a cozy rest when the fun winds down. His balanced energy makes him a great fit for families who want a dog that’s both lively and relaxed. Rodney’s easy-going nature and warm temperament make him a true social butterfly. He thrives on companionship and is happiest when he’s part of family activities, whether that’s going for walks, playing games, or simply hanging out together. If you’re searching for a loving, playful, and well-mannered greyhound who will bring joy and friendship to your home, Rodney is ready and waiting to become your new best friend!

NAME: Sandy
TEXT: Sandy is a stunning young dog, she is playful and fun. She is very sweet and affectionate, she gets along with everyone she meets. Once she is able to move and bust out a morning zoomie or go for a walk she is more than happy to lounge around. She is extremely obedient for a young dog and good to be left alone.

NAME: Barry
TEXT: Barry is beautiful gentle boy. He relaxes well on his own, he is good with kids and is getting good pet prep at the moment with visits to bunnings and local cafes.

NAME: Mitch
TEXT: Meet Mitch! 🐾 Mitch is a friendly and affectionate boy who has a special fondness for fellow medium to large dogs. He’s sociable and gets along well with his larger canine peers, making him a great addition to a home with other dogs. Mitch would be best suited to a family with older children who understand his gentle nature and can enjoy his calm companionship. He has excellent recall, so you can trust him to listen and respond during walks and outings. Affection is Mitch’s love language—he adores pats and treats and will happily soak up all the attention you’re willing to give. He settles quickly into new environments and adapts easily, making transitions smooth and stress-free. Whether at home or on the go, Mitch travels well and is perfectly happy to go in and out of his crate, seeing it as a cozy and safe space. If you’re looking for a loving, well-mannered greyhound who enjoys canine company, gentle affection, and life’s little adventures, Mitch is ready to bring joy to your home.

NAME: Tracker
TEXT: Meet Tracker! 🐕‍🦺 *ATTENDING THE ANU ADOPTION DAY - 6TH SEPTEMBER* Tracker is a big, bold, and lovable greyhound who’s full of personality—and sometimes he forgets just how big he really is! This beautiful boy has a heart as big as his paws and an enthusiasm for life that’s truly contagious. He absolutely adores children, greeting them with excitement and plenty of tail wags, making him a wonderful family companion. Confident and curious, Tracker loves to explore new places and sniff out every interesting corner on his adventures. When he first sets off on a walk, he can be a little eager and pull on the lead as he races ahead, but once he gets into his stride, he settles into a smooth, steady pace that’s a pleasure to walk alongside. Tracker thrives on attention and affection—he’s a social butterfly who loves to be the centre of your world and soak up all the love you can give. His zest for life and friendly nature make him a fantastic companion for active families or anyone looking for a fun-loving, energetic friend. If you’re ready to keep up with a confident, adventurous boy who’s always up for a good time, Tracker is ready to join your family and fill your days with joy and laughter! 👇 Click here for information on the ANU adoption day & to register for the dogalogue

NAME: Magpie
TEXT: Magpie is a very charming and affectionate boy, he is great with other greyhounds and has lived around a Labrador in semi rural environment. Has been walked by kids regularly.

NAME: Precious
TEXT: Meet Precious 💖 *ATTENDING THE ANU ADOPTION DAY - 6TH SEPTEMBER* True to her name, Precious is a delicate and loving girl with a heart full of affection. With so much love to give, Precious is looking for a peaceful home where she can feel safe and cherished.
